mapper.select:
SELECT r.ID, r.NAME, r.DESCRIPTION, r.CATEGORY, r.AVG_RATING, r.RATING_COUNT, r.SOLO_INDEX, r.PHOTO_URL, r.LATITUDE, r.LONGITUDE, r.ADDRESS, r.PHONE FROM MP_RESTAURANT r
r.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND NAME IS NOT NULL
AND r.NAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND r.ID IN ( SELECT RESTAURANT_ID FROM MP_RESTAURANT_TAG WHERE TAG_CODE IN ( SELECT CODE FROM MP_CODE_TAG WHERE TAG IN
#{tag}
) GROUP BY RESTAURANT_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TAG_CODE) = #{tagCount} )
ORDER BY
r.NAME r.AVG_RATING r.SOLO_INDEX r.NAME
DESC NULLS LAST ASC NULLS LAST
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, AVG_RATING, RATING_COUNT, SOLO_INDEX, PHOTO_URL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, ADDRESS, PHONE, AVG_MENU_SCORE, AVG_SEAT_SCORE FROM MP_RESTAURANT WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT t.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, c.tag AS tag FROM mp_code_tag c, mp_restaurant_tag t WHERE c.code = t.tag_code AND t.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MP_RESTAURANT r SET r.RATING_COUNT = ( SELECT COUNT(rw.ID) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.AVG_RATING = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.RATING),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.SOLO_INDEX = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.SOLO_SCORE),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.AVG_MENU_SCORE = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.MENU_SCORE),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.AVG_SEAT_SCORE = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.SEAT_SCORE),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, restaurant_id AS restaurantId, menu AS menu, price, description, origin_info AS originInfo, status FROM mp_restaurant_menu WHERE restaurant_id = #{restaurantId}
